'''Jettison''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and a member of the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Viidu]]'s crew during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
When [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] and [[Syreena]] betrayed Viidu and slaughtered him and most of the gang with the exception of [[Corso Riggs]] who was away from the base on the mission, Jettison caught the massacre on the holocameras and managed to escape before traitors could reach him. He ran for a while and eventually came to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where after some time he tried to remotely access Viidu's old bank account. Not long after that, he was caught by a group of mad militiamen who had turned to cannibalism. Fortunately for Jettison, Corso Riggs noticed him trying to access Viidu's account and tracked his location, which allowed him and the [[Voidhound]] to arrive just in time to save Jettison from a gruesome fate.

Following the ordeal, Jettison got a job testing [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] security in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="Shades of Gray">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Corso Riggs|Shades of Grey}}</ref>
